integrity: Each finite integer computation and acyclic matching is replayable with embedded Python-standard-library checker. Proof of homotopy type uses explicit Morse CW-cell counts and exact integral boundary ranks.
scientific_limitations: Complete classification only for seven-vertex three-arm simple theta graphs with all edges bidirected. No all-length theorem, equivariant character, or independent peer certification.
title: The two seven-vertex subdivisions of K2,3 have distinct bidirected multipath homotopy types
